aka: Senator John Smith of New York
summary: U.S. Rep. 1800–04, U.S. Senator from New York 1804–13, major general of NY militia; John's 3rd cousin 8x removed via Bull Smith.
bio:
Path: Bull Smith → Daniel → Daniel 2d (m. Hannah Brewster) → Mary (m. Judge William Smith of Mastic, 'Tangier' Smith family) → John.

Path (Pelletreau [R4-S1]): Bull Smith -> Daniel -> Daniel 2d -> Mary (b. 25 May 1735, m. Judge William Smith of the Tangier family) -> John: 3rd cousin 8 times removed. Pelletreau adds that for his third wife he married the widow of Henry Nicoll, a daughter of Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull, so he became stepfather of Eliza W. Nicoll, mother of Judge J. Lawrence Smith.
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 476, 491 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
